qa.recommendation: Do not record a planned retirement year for any of the twelve units. Consider adding a note on the plant's status that the owner agreed to keep the units running to May 2031 if PJM needs them.
qa.note: On June 30, 2026 the owner, LSP University Park LLC, sent PJM a deactivation notice for University Park North units 1 to 12 with a retirement date of January 1, 2030. On July 2, 2026 PJM asked for continued operation until May 31, 2031 under the Illinois Climate and Equitable Jobs Act. The same day the owner agreed to that plan and withdrew its deactivation notice in a letter posted on PJM's deactivation page. So the owner has accepted the extension and no deactivation notice stands. A statutory deadline is not a retirement date, so Planned retire stays blank.
